name.description: The name of the application for your reference only.

status.description: The status of the application. Can be `enabled` or `disabled`. Enabled means available to accept inbound connections and all services are available.

fcmServiceAccount.description: Used to specify the Firebase Cloud Messaging(FCM) service account credentials used for authentication and enabling communication with FCM to send push notifications to devices.

fcmProjectId.description: The unique identifier for the Firebase Cloud Messaging(FCM) project. This ID is used to specify the Firebase project when configuring FCM or other Firebase services.

apnsCertificate.description: The Apple Push Notification service certificate.

apnsPrivateKey.description: The Apple Push Notification service private key.

apnsUseSandboxEndpoint.description: Use the Apple Push Notification service sandbox endpoint.
